public_rationale: Oracle reported 200MW operational in Abilene on April 22, 2026 [e6]. public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of April 27, 2026, only two Stargate Abilene buildings are operational and generating revenue, the third barely has any IT gear, and the author estimates the total cost at around $52.8 billion.

statement.excerpt: As of April 27 2026, only two buildings are operational and generating revenue, and the third barely has any IT gear in it. I estimate the total cost of Stargate Abilene to be around $52.8 billion.

from_speaker: only two buildings are operational and generating revenue
the third barely has any IT gear
our_interpretation: The observation concerns the original eight-building Stargate Abilene campus on April 27, excluding adjacent expansion projects.
Operational and generating revenue requires customer service and billing, not merely completed shells, energized equipment, or delivered GPUs.
Barely any IT gear means only a small fraction of the third building's intended equipment; the speaker supplies no numerical threshold.
The cost figure is an April estimate of the completed campus, including IT equipment in the surrounding discussion, rather than spending already incurred.
I do not treat the fact that the author made an estimate as proof that the estimate is accurate.
criteria.support_condition: Records applicable to April 27 establish that exactly two buildings were serving paying customers, that the third had little installed IT equipment, and that a comparable full-campus cost estimate was approximately $52.8 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a different operating-and-billing count, substantial installed equipment in the third building, or a materially different all-in project cost on the same basis.
